subject: english
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Philolegy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Philolegy"** is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Philology,"** which refers to the branch of knowledge that deals with the structure, historical development, and relationships of a language or languages. (ज्ञान की वह शाखा जो किसी भाषा या भाषाओं की संरचना, ऐतिहासिक विकास और संबंधों से संबंधित है)
 
 
• **Example**: *He was the first scholar to transfer the strict standards of **philology**__ to musicology.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Philosophy**: the study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence. (जीवन के अर्थ एवं मतों से संबंधित विचारों का अध्ययन; दर्शन-शास्‍त्र)
 
• **Philanthropy**: the desire to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes. (दान आदि के द्वारा ज़रूरतमंदों की सहायता; परोपकार, लोकोपकार)

 
 
• **Philately**: the collection and study of postage stamps. (डाक टिकट संग्रह एवं संकलन व उनका अध्ययन)
